findings.title: Reflected XSS in /page solution parameter — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description:
The 'solution' POST parameter is reflected unsanitized into the HTML response inside a value attribute context. Two payloads successfully broke out of the attribute and executed alert('XSS'), revealing the CTF flag.

Working payloads:
1. "><script>alert('XSS')</script>
2. " onfocus="alert('XSS')" autofocus

The server validates the XSS payload server-side and returns the flag when a valid XSS vector is submitted.
